metadataRaw.title: Instant Nerve Pain Relief in the Arm and Shoulder
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a quick and easy exercise to relieve sharp shoulder and arm pain caused by a pinched nerve.

It’s especially helpful for pinched nerves from a bulging or herniated disc in the neck—and you can do it right in bed.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
